resources.string: Dira is a temporary helper, not a recorder.\n\nWhen you tap Help, we ask for screen capture permission only to show the next step. Frames stay in memory — we do not keep bank or government screens. You can Stop anytime — then the session is cleared. Sessions also end after 5 minutes.
